title: Verify the complete supported desktop-style workflow
description: Close the release gate with end-to-end evidence, security/accessibility checks, and an accurate capability matrix for the implemented GitHub 3D client.
acceptanceCriteria: Automated or documented evidence covers sign-in, repository create/open/clone, branch operations, diffs, staging, commit, sync, conflict recovery, history, pull-request context, and 3D/2D workflow consistency for supported behavior.
Credential handling, permission denial/revocation, destructive actions, local data retention, and logging are reviewed against the threat model.
Performance and accessibility targets are measured on representative environments and known limits are recorded.
The product docs and README distinguish implemented capabilities from deferred or unsupported ones; no unsupported parity claim remains.

steps.details: Added the current evidence matrix to docs/09-testing-and-acceptance.md; it separates automated, runtime, and unverified claims.

steps.description: Run required automated and runtime checks
steps.details: Focused Git/API/model coverage passed (36 tests); bun run typecheck passed; and bun run build -- --outDir /tmp/github-3d-dist passed with the existing large-chunk warning. Managed IWSDK runtime launched with SwiftShader, rendered the demo scene, and accepted named spatial input, but no authenticated session was available to open a real workspace. Live auth, full browser workflow, 2D keyboard-only completion, WebGL fallback, and representative performance remain unverified; aggregate bun run test remains 32 passed and 3 pre-existing failures.

steps.description: Document release status and remaining gaps
steps.details: Updated README and acceptance docs to distinguish implemented workflows from unsupported behavior and the open release gate.

technicalNotes: A full release gate may require this task to be split into smaller test tasks before implementation.
Do not deploy, publish, or push without explicit authorization.
